S1: Eight programs later, still lifting the same weight.
S2: The idea is to confuse your muscles.
But muscles don't get confused. They grow when the same lift slowly gets heavier. Switch every week, and you never repeat a lift long enough to add weight.
S3: So pick one program and run it for eight weeks.
Same lifts, and add one rep or a little weight each week.
